paper.title: Fermionic Wave Functions from Neural-Network Constrained Hidden States
paper.authors: Javier Robledo Moreno, Giuseppe Carleo, Antoine Georges, James Stokes

results.system_description: 16x4 rectangular lattice (Lx = 16, Ly = 4), periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t' = 0; 56 electrons (28 up, 28 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.variant: HFDS, 16 hidden fermions, fully connected network, PBC-PBC
results.source_location: Table IV, p. 20 (row L = 16, column HFDS (PBC-PBC))
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the hidden-fermion determinant state on the 4 × 16 lattice with periodic boundaries in both directions at n = 7/8 and U = 8.
results.notes: Cross-checked with varbench Hubbard/rectangular-4x16_64_P_28_8: total energy -48.192(3), i.e. -0.753 per site. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
